messages:
maria: Heads-up: deploy-bot is seeing a spike in 5xx from eu-edge after last night's release. Suspect change in tokenizer path. I want to push an expedited hotfix + pin back to tokenizer v2.1.1 for eu regions only. Need quick approvals and canary plan.

deploy-bot: [automated] anomaly detected: service=tokenizer region=eu-edge metric=5xx_rate baseline=0.2% current=1.8% window=12m suspect_commit=c3f4b9a affected_nodes=3

ben: confirmed we saw higher error logs and a handful of OOM traces on the new allocator path. quick mitigation = pin to v2.1.1 (previous stable) on eu pools, then rollout patch later.

maria: Proposed plan: 1) Pin tokenizer service to v2.1.1 on eu-east (canary 5%) 2) wait 15m for error-rate, 99p latency, memory; 3) if green -> rollout to eu-west and eu-central (staggered) 4) if failure -> immediate rollback to v2.1.1 across eu. Rollback criteria listed below.

anya: Rollback / abort criteria I want in the runbook: - 5xx increase >1.0 percentage point vs baseline for 5m OR - sustained 99p latency increase >200ms for 5m OR - pod memory >85% for 3 consecutive minutes. If any hit, auto-fail canary and stop rollout; oncall to ack.

tom: Can we do a graceful traffic shift? Use 5% traffic to canary, then 25% if green. Also, add fallback routing to old tokenizer variant in region if unhealthy.

ben: Command I will run to pin (manual ops):
```
rlsctl pin --service=tokenizer --version=v2.1.1 --regions=eu-east --traffic=5%
```
I'll start the pin once we get approvals. It takes ~40s to apply and health checks start immediately.

maria: Approvals needed: eng-oncall (tom), infra (ben), SRE (anya), and release lead (maria) - I'm signing off but need explicit thumbs from others for expedited deploy window. This is within the maintenance window (now).

evelyn: +1 expedited from PM/ops. Go for it, prioritize reducing user impact. :thumbsup:

anya: +1 SRE. watching.

tom: +1 oncall. I'll monitor and stand by for rollback.

ben: starting pin now. running command.

deploy-bot: [action] pin initiated by ben: service=tokenizer target=v2.1.1 regions=eu-east traffic=5% id=deploy-8462

ben: pin applied. health checks: 3/3 green, rolling window 2m.

maria: Holding for the 15m validation window. @tom @anya please call the rollback if you see criteria.

anya: 6m in: error-rate down to 0.25% in canary, 99p latency stable, memory stable. continuing watch.

tom: 12m in: canary metrics look good. no error bursts. ready to increase to 25%.

ben: increasing traffic to 25% for eu-east and starting canary in eu-west at 5%.

deploy-bot: [action] traffic update: deploy-8462 eu-east=25% eu-west=5%

maria: If the next 10m stays green we'll roll to eu-central and full EU. Ben, coordinate rollout schedule.

ben: rolling to eu-central canary 5% now.

deploy-bot: [status] deploy-8462 eu-central=5% health=healthy

anya: 9m after expansion: metrics stable across eu regions. No memory regressions.

maria: OK pushing to full EU rollout (gradual, 10 min steps). Everyone standby.

ben: full rollout in progress.

deploy-bot: [final] deploy-8462 completed: service=tokenizer regions=eu-all final_version=v2.1.1 note="hotfix pin for eu-edge 5xx"

evelyn: Nice work, team. Please add a short note to release notes: "Hotfix: tokenizer pinned to v2.1.1 in EU to mitigate 5xx spike; follow-up patch planned."

maria: Added to release notes and will schedule postmortem to find root cause. Closing thread after 24h of stability. :white_check_mark:
